criterion.name: judge_accepts
criterion.description: 1.0 when the Lean judge accepts the submitted certificate under the official Stage-2 proof policy, 0.0 otherwise. Nothing here judges correctness itself.

preflight.name: submission_present
argv: import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('submission.lean'); sys.exit(0 if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size > 0 else 'submission.lean is missing or empty')
